reviews.snippet: Your rent is incredibly expensive." It's very bad, and I'd give it the lowest star. Honestly, it doesn't deserve even one star. The prices for travel are terrible, especially now with the orders you place and the drivers' prices, which are excessively high. It doesn't deserve a single star. Five months ago, the app was great for travel and booking trips, but after the update, it became terrible for travel.

Worst ride-booking app I have ever used — inDrive! The prices are always ₹20–₹30 higher compared to other ride apps. Even then, drivers often don’t want to accept the ride unless you offer ₹30–₹40 extra. Today, an inDrive bike ride of just 4.4 km costs around ₹95, which feels unnecessarily expensive compared to other options. On top of that, getting a driver to accept the ride can be a frustrating experience. Overall, the pricing and driver acceptance system seriously need improvement.

Terrible service and completely unprofessional staff. Customer support is useless and doesn’t even try to solve the problem. On top of that, their GPS is always inaccurate — it constantly takes me to the wrong location or causes delays. This isn’t the first time, and clearly, they’re not interested in fixing it. I’ll never use their service again and I strongly advise others to stay away.

Hi! Your InDrive app is very good, but I have a request: please bring back the destination option that you had before, which made it easier for drivers to pick rides. The destination option means the driver could provide 2 locations, so that only rides between those 2 locations would be shown to the driver, making it easier for him to pick a suitable ride. Thank you.

great app to save money for commute but takes time to book. even if there are drivers around the area, they will not take your ride simply because you have a promotion to lower down the fee and if they think it is is not worth it , they won't pick you up. Grab Is expensive but whenever I book a ride, there is already a driver picking up my ride within a minute. in indrive, I need to wait for like 20 minutes. kind of disappointed ☹️

There is unfair treatment towards the drivers. They travel one and a half, two, or even three kilometers to reach the pickup location, but then the ride gets canceled. Sometimes there are four or five passengers, which means extra weight, and at times there is luggage as well. In many cases, the actual destination is different from the location entered in the app, and passengers ask the driver to go to unpaved roads or other places. Moreover, the fare for drivers is extremely low.

There is unfair treatment towards the drivers. They travel one and a half, two, or even three kilometers to reach the pickup location, but then the ride gets cancelled. Sometimes there are four or five passengers, which means extra weight, and at times there is luggage as well. In many cases, the actual destination is different from the location entered in the app, and passengers ask the driver to go to unpaved roads or other places. Moreover, the fare for drivers is extremely low.

The inDrive system is frustrating for drivers. There is no proper passenger category, so you can drive 5–8 km to collect a passenger only to find that 5–7 people are trying to fit into a 5-seater. Waiting 5–10 minutes for passengers is also unpaid, and if they don’t show up, the driver loses out while the fare is placed on hold for investigation. The voucher top-up system is inconvenient because not all outlets sell vouchers, meaning drivers sometimes have to stop working.

app is allowing the driver to send offer more than the rate posted. so while im waiting for the driver to pop up on my booking. i accepted it like normal process. i didnt see that there is a 31myr offer from that driver. because it is not the usual process of the app. its kinda redundant because rider user also can add tip to get offer. so i think this not the usual process and unacceptable. its misleading to the end user. indrive should take action regarding.

I have a suggestion for the inDrive app. Please add a waiting charge feature for drivers. Sometimes passengers make drivers wait for several minutes after reaching the pickup location, which wastes the driver’s time and fuel. A reasonable waiting charge after a free waiting period (for example, 5 minutes) would make the system fair for both drivers and passengers. Please consider adding this feature in a future update. Thank you! 🙏

I ordered a courier through InDrive and paid an extra amount because I needed the goods urgently. However, the driver arrived very late and did not respond to my calls. I also tried contacting InDrive support through the app, but I did not receive any response to my messages. When the driver finally arrived, I tried to report the issue through the app, but the app automatically went back and did not allow me to submit the report. I then checked my trip history, but the courier order was not show

Very frustrating experience for a new driver. Requests disappear within seconds, and even when I accept the passenger's exact fare, the offer can still be declined. A passenger confirmed my pickup, I travelled to the airport, spent fuel and paid a gate fee, then she cancelled. The trip disappeared, making it difficult to report. I was then charged #541.37 and my account was restricted from receiving requests while the payment is under review. New drivers already struggle to get their first trip

The app only care about making money, which wouldn't be a problem, if they had a costumer support service. A driver can cancel a ride without you knowing and without notification, a driver can be disrespectful, and you can't contact the support unless the drive is completed, which leave you as a user stuck, especially when you have important things to do, and you want safe option, don't count on indrive unfortunately. From a 3+ years user. and good luck having the support to reach out to.

In many cases, the actual destination is different from the location entered in the app, and passengers ask the driver to go to unpaved roads or other places. inDrive is one of the best ride-hailing apps because it offers fair pricing and reliable service. I have one suggestion that would make the app even better. Please add a 7-seater vehicle option for passengers traveling in groups of six or seven. Currently, large families or groups often have to book two separate cars, which increases both the cost and the inconvenience. A dedicated 7-seater category would allow everyone to travel together comfortably in a single ride.

App is forcing a longer route to be used to get home which is expensive. Going to the initial destination I booked a shorter route which was cheaper and confirmed it can also be used to get back home. to use the old route App is requiring me to book additional stop which has additional payment but is cheaper overall than the long route, but is more pricey if they stick with just the short route

The app should add waiting time because a lot of clients take advantage to take their time because the price will not change. And some destinations are too far from the nearest landmark. In this case the app should continue calculating so that at the end of the ride an actual price is should because of extra distance. A radius of 200m is acceptable.

Prices are too high. Earlier the app used to show a minus (-) sign option to reduce fare but now the amount is fixed and I can only increase the fare. The problem is the fixed fare shown is way too high and drivers do not accept unless more money is added to the recommended fare. This is insane and the option to reduce the fare should be returned.

the best app so far, nobody is closed to In drive, the only thing you need to add is that when someone accept our ride, show he's number also, because we have to contact him first through the app messaging app, ask for number and then we are contacting each other. otherwise there's no other options to contact with the drivers

I just loveeee the app, competitive price as I always like my options, comparing them with the other 2 green apps. been recommending it to my friends, to good feedback. keep up the good work! the gps / map is slightly off when it comes to guiding its drivers tho. kinda hard when u were in a rush..
